parameters.description_en: A client token used to ensure the idempotence of the request. parameters.description_en: The name of the key pair. The name must be 2 to 64 characters in length. It must start with a letter or a Chinese character. It cannot start with http\:// or https\://. The name can contain digits, colons (:), underscores (\_), and hyphens (-).
parameters.description_zh: 密钥对名称。长度为2~64个英文或中文字符。必须以大小写字母或中文开头，不能以http://或https://开头。可以包含数字、半角冒号（:）、下划线（_）或者短划线（-）。
